# Rayon Lab Tech — Comprehensive Technical Documentation & Knowledge Base

> Manufacturer of Laboratory Furniture, Chemical Fume Hoods, Anti-Vibration Tables, and Exhaust Systems in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Executive Summary
Rayon Lab Tech is an industrial manufacturing company specializing in turn-key design, engineering, fabrication, and installation of laboratory infrastructure across India. The company delivers heavy-duty modular workbenches, central island tables, ducted fume extraction hoods, cleanroom stainless steel furniture, and vibration-isolated instrument tables for pharmaceutical, petrochemical, chemical, educational, diagnostic, and industrial research environments.

## Core Product Portfolio & Engineering Specifications

### 1. Modular Laboratory Furniture & Working Tables
- **Frame Designs**: C-Frame, H-Frame, and Pedestal mounted modular architecture.
- **Material of Construction (MOC)**: Prime CRCA / Galvanized Iron (GI) steel sheets (1.0mm - 1.5mm thickness).
- **Surface Finish**: Pure Epoxy powder coating (60-80 micron dry film thickness) subjected to multi-stage pre-treatment (degreasing, phosphating, passivation) for superior acid and alkali chemical resistance.
- **Worktop Options**:
  - 18mm (+/-1mm) thick natural Black Granite with bevelled / chamfered edges.
  - Solid Epoxy Resin slabs with high thermal and chemical inertness.
  - Phenolic Resin (Trespa / Compact Laminate) for extreme moisture and stain resistance.
- **Ergonomic Standards**: Standing working height (900mm / 3 ft) and Sitting working height (750mm / 2.5 ft). Lengths modular from 1200mm to 3600mm.
- **Integrated Utilities**: Two-tier electrical trunking/channels, splash-proof multi-pin sockets (6A/16A), gas/vacuum service valves, overhead LED task lighting.

### 2. Central Island Workstations
- **Purpose**: Multi-user collaboration for central laboratory layouts with dual-sided bench access.
- **Features**: Centrally mounted reagent distribution shelves, integrated polypropylene (PP) sinks with bottle trap, 3-way brass faucets with epoxy coating, emergency eye wash stations, and beneath-bench customizable modular under-bench storage drawers/cabinets.

### 3. Chemical Laboratory Fume Hoods
- **Standards Compliance**: SEFA-1, ASHRAE 110, EN 14175 standards.
- **Aerodynamics & Flow**: Constant Air Volume (CAV) / Variable Air Volume (VAV) compatible, face velocity calibrated at 80-100 FPM (feet per minute) at standard sash opening height.
- **Liner & Baffles**: Chemical-resistant compact phenolic resin / polypropylene liner with three-point aerodynamic baffle slots for heavy, medium, and light gas scavenging.
- **Sash**: 5mm-6mm toughened safety glass with counterbalanced weight mechanism and smooth vertical sliding motion.
- **Safety**: Built-in vapor-proof LED lighting, auxiliary electrical outlets, FLP (flame-proof) options available, and internal utility service valves for nitrogen, compressed air, and water.

### 4. Precision Anti-Vibration Balance Tables
- **Purpose**: Isolation of high-precision analytical balances (up to 0.0001g sensitivity), HPLC, and micro-spectrophotometry instruments from building vibrations.
- **Design**: Dual-frame decoupled architecture (outer heavy-duty support table completely isolated from inner high-density inert granite slab supported on elastomeric vibration-damping pads).

### 5. Centrifugal Exhaust Blowers & Wet Scrubbers
- **Material**: High-efficiency PP/FRP (polypropylene / fiberglass reinforced plastic) casing and dynamic balanced backward/forward curved impeller.
- **Motor**: Chemical-resistant TEFC IP55 motor / Flame-proof (FLP) motor.
- **Wet Scrubbers**: Vertical packed-bed fume scrubbers with spray nozzle manifold, demister pad, and recirculation pump for neutralising toxic acid fumes.

### 6. Stainless Steel (SS 304 / SS 316) Cleanroom Furniture
- **Grade**: High-purity AISI SS 304 or SS 316 with satin/matte #4 finish.
- **Applications**: Pharmaceutical cleanrooms (Class 100 / Class 1000 / Class 10000), microbiology labs, food processing units, and hospital sterile facilities.
- **Products**: SS Working Tables, Cross-Over Benches, SS Sinks, Garment Storage Cubicles, SS Trollies, and Dynamic Pass Boxes.

---

## Quality Assurance & Compliance Standards
- **ISO Quality Systems**: Strict adherence to ISO quality management protocols.
- **SEFA Compliance**: Scientific Equipment and Furniture Association guidelines for mechanical loading, structural rigidity, and chemical resistance testing.
- **Safety Testing**: High-voltage electrical insulation tests, air-flow velocity tests, and chemical spot tests.
